typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblcalypsotradeservProductCdsSng_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		PRODUCT_ID as decimal(38,0),
		REF_ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		LONG_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromrefentitysingle
fromrefentitysingle derive({Copy of PRODUCT_ID} = toString(PRODUCT_ID),
		{Copy of LONG_NAME} = LONG_NAME,
		{Copy of LEGAL_ENTITY_ID} = toString(LEGAL_ENTITY_ID),
		{Copy of REF_ENTITY_ID} = toString(REF_ENTITY_ID),
		{Copy of SHORT_NAME} = SHORT_NAME) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as string,
		PRODUCT_ID as string,
		REF_ENTITY_ID as string,
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		long_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = {Copy of LEGAL_ENTITY_ID},
		PRODUCT_ID = {Copy of PRODUCT_ID},
		REF_ENTITY_ID = {Copy of REF_ENTITY_ID},
		SHORT_NAME = {Copy of SHORT_NAME},
		long_name = {Copy of LONG_NAME}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblcalypsotradeservProductCdsSng_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblcalypsotradeservProductCdsSng
